findings.location: content.body.ruleUk: "Використовуй звичайну клавіатуру з латинською розкладкою (наприклад, ABC або іспанською)." together with "¡ — Option+1, ¿ — Option+Shift+/."
findings.description: The punctuation shortcuts are presented as applying to both ABC and Spanish layouts. They are layout-dependent: on Spanish ISO, Option+1 produces |. The instruction therefore fails for an explicitly supported layout.
findings.suggestion: Specify that these shortcuts apply to Mac ABC, and provide separately verified punctuation instructions for the supported Spanish layout.

items.reviewerAnswer: Character-entry instructions must distinguish the active keyboard layout; the stated punctuation shortcuts work with Mac ABC.
items.notes: content.body.scope.noteUk explicitly records that the combinations have not been verified on the supported devices.
sources: Apple, Mac User Guide, “Use the Keyboard Viewer on Mac”: characters depend on the selected input source (from memory).
macOS Spanish ISO input-source mapping, Option+1 → | (from memory).

findings.location: content.body.steps[0].blocks[2].items[0]: "Mac (розкладка ABC або іспанська): затисни a, e, i, o, u чи n і вибери потрібний варіант у меню; ¡ — Option+1, ¿ — Option+Shift+/."
findings.description: The bullet applies ABC punctuation shortcuts to the Spanish layout as well. Keyboard mappings differ; on Spanish ISO, Option+1 produces |.
findings.suggestion: Limit these shortcuts to ABC and provide separately verified instructions for the supported Spanish layout.

findings.location: task.prompt[0].text: "Пам’ятай: над голосною в іспанській пишуть лише знак ´."; task.feedback.incorrectUk: "Ні. В іспанській над голосною буває лише знак ´: adiós."
findings.description: These statements incorrectly exclude every mark above a vowel except ´. Spanish also uses the diaeresis in ü, including the lesson's words pingüino and bilingüe. The answer key itself is correct.
findings.suggestion: Specify that ´ is the Spanish written stress mark, rather than the only mark that can appear above a vowel. Amend both the prompt and incorrect feedback.

items.notes: The hint correctly limits its statement to «знак наголосу» and needs no corresponding change.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, entry «diéresis», orthographic use over u in güe and güi (from memory).

findings.location: task.prompt[0].text: "Напиши іспанською напис на пакунку: «Кава з Іспанії»."; task.prompt[1]: "de" — "з (звідки)".
findings.description: Producing the label requires the noun + de + country construction. context.taughtBefore identifies orthographic skills and vocabulary, but no origin construction. The prompt glosses de without supplying the construction, so this first-lesson task requires an untaught grammatical prerequisite.
findings.suggestion: Supply the frame «___ de ___» and ask learners to enter the Spanish words for coffee and Spain, or teach the origin construction before this task.

items.notes: Café de España is correct Spanish; the defect concerns the prerequisite.
sources: Course contract, rule 1: required constructions must be taught beforehand or supplied in the prompt or a hint.
Packet: this case's context.taughtBefore and task.prompt; no origin construction is listed or modeled.
